description: Sidewalk condition rating 2021 is a dataset listed in City of Vancouver Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Vancouver. Sidewalk condition data, collected in 2021, is used to report the overall sidewalk condition index (SCI) at the network level and expresses the overall condition of a sidewalk segment by considering surface distresses identified manually in the field. Distresses were collected as point data. Coverage: Vancouver. The portal files it under Streets and transportation. The portal shows 15,580 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-vancouver-ca-portal.
